newsitem.title: ITALY: STAR TV launches Middle East package with Orbit.
newsitem.headline: STAR TV launches Middle East package with Orbit.

text.p: News Corporation subsidiary STAR TV and Saudi-owned Orbit Satellite Television announced the launch on Tuesday of a new package of six television channels customised for the Middle East, Orbit said in a statement.

The Rome-based pay-television service said in a statement that the all-English package, STAR Select, would be available on Orbit's digital receiver at $20 a month, with the first month free and discounts for annual or six-monthly payment.

The channels comprise STAR Plus International, STAR Movies, STAR Sports, NBC, CNBC, and the Fox Kids Network, the statement said. It said three more channels, Sky News, Channel (V) International and Viva Cinema would be added in April.
